join.key_tried: PDB 4-char id (catalogue PDB_ID_and_Entity / protein_id, validation NN# prefix stripped) vs eval protein name; plus case-insensitive substring scan of both catalogue id columns

structural_features_source.note: computed directly on the 28 test proteins because the catalogue join is empty

multiple_testing.note: Bonferroni over the full feature x target scan. Only these clear it; everything else, including every b_p result, is suggestive at best at n=28.

zero_variance_features_on_test_set.note: All 28 MegaScale test proteins are single-chain, ligand-free, metal-free monomers (43-72 aa). Complexity, ligands and true inter-chain BSA have ZERO variance here and are unmeasurable in principle on this test set - not "no effect", untestable.

metric_rule_note: The prior BSA-vs-pretraining-decoy-loss check (r=-0.001) used the wrong metric. Decoy loss is decoy discrimination on PDB and is known not to predict ddG. A whole-protein property is identical between WT and mutant and cancels in ddG, so it can only be scored on b_p / a_p / per-protein PCC. This analysis does that.
headline: Catalogue join is EMPTY (0/28, verified by exact PDB-id and full substring scan) because the catalogue is the PDB pre-training set and the 28 are held-out MegaScale monomers. Covariates were therefore computed directly on the 28 AlphaFold models. Strongest real signal: relative solvent exposure vs the SLOPE a_p (mean_rel_SASA r=+0.714, p=2e-5, Bonferroni-surviving), NOT vs b_p. Nothing survives Bonferroni against b_p.
